title: Generic source etaleness after root normalization
statement: With the hypotheses of the root normalization construction, every point of the finite relative normalization lying over the generic point of the root divisor has a source open neighbourhood on which the normalization morphism is etale.

source.place: Tags 09EB and 0BRM, and Tag 0EYG root-extension paragraph.

proof.text: The root algebra is Noetherian and regular at every prime containing the root coordinate, by the regular root-algebra theorem. The generic-point calculation identifies the root divisor and the finite normalization points above it.

For each generic torsor component, the Galois ramification indices divide the group order and the residue extensions are tame because the group order is invertible. Abhyankar’s lemma for the group-order root gives ramification index one and separable residue fields, hence the finite normalization is etale at each point above the generic divisor point.
Etaleness is open on a finite morphism over a locally Noetherian scheme, yielding a source open neighbourhood at each normalization point.

theorem GaloisCover.root_normalization_generic_source_etale
    {L U : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ L)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (W : GaloisCover G U)
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : Spec R ⟶ L) (f : R)
    (β : pullback i φ ≅ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f))
    (hβ : β.hom ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) = pullback.snd i φ)
    (H : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing H] (b : R ⟶ H)
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : H)) (hg : IsSMulRegular H (b.hom f))
    [IsDomain (H ⧸ Ideal.span {b.hom f})] :
    let g := b.hom f
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H A g)
    (∀ (Q : Ideal A) (hQ : Q.IsPrime),
      letI := hQ
      AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g) ∈ Q →
        IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime Q)) →
    ∀ (hN : IsLocallyNoetherian N),
    letI := hN
    let p := pullback.snd (W.π ≫ i) (V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map b ≫ φ)
    ∀ (hp : IsFinite p),
    letI := hp
    let a := p ≫ V.ι
    Etale p → IsFinite a.fromNormalization →
    ∀ (D : Scheme.{u}) (j : D ⟶ N),
      IsRegular D → IsIntegral D → IsEffectiveCartierCenter j →
      (∀ z : N, z ∈ V ↔ z ∉ Set.range j) →
      ∀ (η : D), IsGenericPoint η Set.univ →
      ∀ x : a.normalization, a.fromNormalization x = j η →
        ∃ E : a.normalization.Opens, x ∈ E ∧ Etale (E.ι ≫ a.fromNormalization)
